cases.prompt: Find three additional repeatable draw creatures for Marchesa. Prefer low casting cost and explain activation costs and prerequisites.

- Repeatable draw creatures (low CMC preferred): Mystic Archaeologist ({1}{U}) — Low-cost repeatable draw creature whose activation converts mana into two cards without consuming the body. Requires repeated mana; better card advantage than Azure Mage but slower than Mercurial Chemister's cheaper activation. Relevant deck support remains unconfirmed. Activation cost: {3}{U}{U}.
- Repeatable draw creatures (low CMC preferred): Roil Cartographer ({1}{U}) — Low-cost repeatable draw creature that can convert stored energy into three cards per activation. Requires untapped creature plus six energy, and its landfall energy generation alone is slow; stronger draw burst than Azure Mage but less reliable than Mystic Archaeologist. Relevant deck support remains unconfirmed. Printed card text (ability availability unverified): “Landfall — Whenever a land you control enters, you get {E} (an energy counter).
{T}, Pay six {E}: Draw three cards.” Tap-symbol cost: this creature needs continuous control or haste.
- Repeatable draw creatures (low CMC preferred): Mercurial Chemister ({3}{U}{R}) — Repeatable draw creature with an efficient blue activation that draws two cards without sacrificing itself. Requires untapped creature and blue mana each time; higher casting cost than the two-drop options but far cheaper activation than Mystic Archaeologist or Roil Cartographer. Relevant deck support remains unconfirmed. Printed card text (ability availability unverified): “{U}, {T}: Draw two cards.
{R}, {T}, Discard a card: This creature deals damage to target creature equal to the discarded card's mana value.” Tap-symbol cost: this creature needs continuous control or haste.
